#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --output=test.out

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:4
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without GPUs (or fewer than 4), causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: -p gpu-normal (partition)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on non-GPU nodes or have different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3

flux run -n 1 -c 1 python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=4 train_retrieval.py \
  --config ./configs/retrieval_flickr_small6.yaml \
  --output_dir output/retrieval_flickr
"
}
